stories.headline: U.S. spot Bitcoin ETFs log ~$999M Monday — biggest day since Oct 2025

stories.blurb: CryptoSlate/CryptoQuant: profit-taking into the rebound is offsetting fresh ETF demand after the push toward $87–88k.

stories.headline: 2026 BTC ETF YTD flows flip back to net positive after mid-year hole
stories.blurb: Bloomberg’s Balchunas track: multi-billion recovery since mid-July erased the earlier 2026 deficit; annual tally back in the black.

stories.headline: Farside: Wed 23 Sep BTC ETF flows cool to +$32.4M after the surge
stories.blurb: After Mon/Tue megadays, Wednesday’s print was a small net inflow; ETH ETFs +$2.5M the same session (our Farside parse).

stories.headline: Glassnode: sell-side risk cools; ~$86k still cited as ETF cost-basis zone
